backend/main.mo: Defines the main canister with storage mixins, authorization, and data models for exercises, blog posts, products, memberships, user profiles, and queries/mutations for profile access and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a one-character text update to ContactPage.tsx and listing related components and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of various frontend files, describing their purpose and recent updates across pages, components, and hooks.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Documentation explaining how to build, deploy, and locate the live .icp0.io URL for the app, with guidance on troubleshooting and next steps.
frontend/DOMAIN_SETUP.md: Guide for configuring a custom domain for the deployed app, including DNS steps for GoDaddy and Cloudflare and verification instructions.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer and CSS variable definitions establishing light/dark theme tokens and global styling for the app.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point loading the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration, global layout, and all application routes including domain setup, dashboard, blog, and store pages.
frontend/src/components/CopyToClipboardC: Button component that copies provided text to clipboard with success/failure toasts and fallback logic for older browsers.
frontend/src/components/creator/Affiliat: Admin tool for listing, creating, editing, and deleting Amazon affiliate products with validation and dialog forms.
frontend/src/components/creator/BlogMana: Admin interface for manually managing blog posts including create, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete operations.
frontend/src/components/creator/Breathwo: Empty placeholder file for future breathwork management functionality.
frontend/src/components/creator/Exercise: Admin interface for creating, editing, and deleting exercises with muscle group, equipment, media, and cue data.
frontend/src/components/creator/MuscleGr: UI for viewing and editing muscle group cards, handling form state, validation, and update mutations.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders site footer with branding, quick links, and social icons using a 3‑column layout.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with centered logo, navigation links, music toggle, and conditional admin dashboard access.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout wrapper that displays the header, routed content, and footer.
frontend/src/components/membership/Start: Button that creates a Stripe checkout session and redirects users to start a membership purchase.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous actor and invalidates queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides internet identity login state, loading, and management via AuthClient and React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useMusicPlayer.tsx: Zustand-based music player hook managing audio playback, volume, and lifecycle of a background audio element.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks wrapping actor calls for exercises, muscle groups, products, membership, and related mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom theme variables for dark mode, including brand colors and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that initializes React, QueryClient, and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page with hero imagery, a quote overlay, and a detailed founder story section. Emphasizes branding, visuals, and narrative content about Stefan Philip Sweeting.
frontend/src/pages/AffiliateStorePage.ts: Displays an affiliate store with a hero banner, optional disclosure, and a product grid fetched from hooks. Handles loading, empty states, and product display cards.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPage.tsx: Shows blog post previews with a hero section, quote overlay, and article grid. Integrates admin controls and membership checks when listing posts.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders a single blog post with hero metadata, access control for member‑only content, and fallbacks for missing or loading posts. Includes navigation and formatted date display.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides contact information, support emails, and quick navigation links. Features a styled header and cards for support and inquiry details.
Admin-only dashboard with tabbed management sections for exercises, muscle groups, blog posts, and affiliate store items, including access checks and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/DomainSetupPage.tsx: Displays instructions and DNS details for connecting a custom domain, pulling deployment data and showing alerts, guidance, and copyable configuration values.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero imagery, membership and library navigation buttons, and sections highlighting fitness principles and motivational content.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Shows a failure message when a payment cannot be processed and offers navigation to retry payment or contact support.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Validates Stripe session status, handles loading and error states, updates membership queries, and shows success or failure messages after checkout.
frontend/src/pages/ProgramsPage.tsx: Showcases training programs with hero and quote sections, including a featured program card and a placeholder purchase handler.
frontend/src/pages/UserDashboardPage.tsx: React page managing user authentication, membership status, and profile creation with dialogs and conditional UI states. Handles login/logout, profile saving, and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/WorkoutLibraryPage.ts: Displays exercise library grouped by muscle groups with collapsible sections, membership gating, and fallback images. Fetches exercise previews and supports navigation and authentication checks.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions to read, store, persist, and clear URL and session-based parameters. Supports both standard and hash-based routing and safe session storage handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugin integration. Extends theme values and defines container and content scanning settings.
project_state.json: Describes current project state focused on triggering a rebuild to fix missing frontend deployment, along with tracked issues and feature metadata.
